use.flag: Install /usr/share/claude-code and managed settings that override ~/.claude. Off by default, so Claude reads the user home directory.

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal. This package drops the bottom rule of the prompt on every build. With USE=settings it also installs spinner-to-status under /usr/share/claude-code and pins the dark theme, the classic renderer, high effort for Opus 5.5, the gopls language server, and WebFetch for docs.cloud.google.com.
